Removing the source caused node2's copy to be removed automatically in 60 seconds.
Healthy baseline boot ID `6ab98831…`, acknowledged restart, new boot ID `a050c305…`, and recovered timer plus successful synchronization are proven.
Healthy baseline boot ID `b185f188…`, acknowledged restart, new boot ID `8d0d2930…`, and recovered SSH/receiver state are proven.
After both restarts, a new source file synchronized byte-for-byte to node2; its subsequent deletion also synchronized, leaving both nodes in the original absent state.

sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
case "${1:-}" in
  put)
    tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    cat > "$tmp"
    chown root:root "$tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" /etc/inventory/app.conf
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    ;;
  delete)
    rm -f /etc/inventory/app.conf
    ;;
  *)
    echo 'unsupported inventory sync operation' >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-sync-command >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
case "${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}" in
  'inventory-sync put') exec sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive put ;;
  'inventory-sync delete') exec sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive delete ;;
  *) echo 'unauthorized inventory sync command' >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-sync-command
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/bin/inventory-sync-command
install -d -m 0700 "$HOME/.ssh"
keyline='command="/usr/local/bin/inventory-sync-command",no-agent-forwarding,no-port-forwarding,no-X11-forwarding,no-pty ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINpLQvWhJ5DBCD7nHQ/wnfdSI961lPuMT/YxoT11Fmam inventory-sync@node1'
touch "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chmod 0600 "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
grep -qxF "$keyline" "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys" || printf '%s\n' "$keyline" >> "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
printf 'receiver_sha256='; sha256sum /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive
printf 'command_sha256='; sha256sum /usr/local/bin/inventory-sync-command
printf 'authorized_key_count='; grep -c 'inventory-sync@node1' "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
